result:
The proposed answer is not supported, so I reject it.

The reasoning contradicts itself. It first claims the set is {0, 1/3, 2/5, 1/2, 2/3, 1}, then drops 1 and 2/3, then adds 2/3 back, and then settles on {1/3, 2/5, 1/2} with sum 37/30. It also cites an "official IMC 2021 solution" giving sum 19/10, which conflicts with its own conclusion. None of these claims is justified. The step from these sets to the final value 2 is simply asserted, and no sum of the candidate values equals 2 under any consistent reading. For example, 1/3 + 2/5 + 1/2 alone is 37/30 ≈ 1.23, and adding 2/3 gives 1.9, so reaching exactly 2 would need a different, unstated set of values.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 3
